builds.name: Reference: Ranked jungle core
builds.goal: Reference for Amumu: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ jungle players use most (2,772 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 57.7% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: An engage tank whose repeated close-range magic damage supports an allied magic-damage follow-up. His curse and two Bandage Toss charges favor staying near enemies after initiation. The current jungle provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Liandry's Torment → Sunfire Aegis → Abyssal Mask. Conqueror keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Jak'Sho, The Protean, Randuin's Omen.
builds.summary: The proven jungle baseline: Liandry's Torment → Sunfire Aegis → Abyssal Mask, with Conqueror.
testPlan: Play it in jungle as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Liandry's Torment → Sunfire Aegis → Abyssal Mask) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 57.7% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Liandry's Torment → Sunfire Aegis → Abyssal Mask.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

builds.name: Attack curse duelist
builds.summary: Test attack curse duelist against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test attack curse duelist against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Cursed Touch begins with Amumu's own attack, then Despair refreshes it; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn add magic attack packets alongside AP-scaled W. Abyssal Mask increases nearby enemy magic damage taken, making a melee attack phase worth testing after Bandage Toss.
testPlan: Required state: Stay near a cursed target and weave attacks between Q charges.
Compare cursed magic packets and total duel damage over eight seconds.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low reach and uninterrupted incoming burst can prevent three attacks.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The passive is not permission to apply item on-hits through every Despair tick.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Magic matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Amumu: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: An engage tank whose repeated close-range magic damage supports an allied magic-damage follow-up. His curse and two Bandage Toss charges favor staying near enemies after initiation. Can repeated W/E contact and passive magic vulnerability justify AP/burn purchases after a reliable Q/R engage? Include allied magic damage and time spent near enemies. MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
builds.summary: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Amumu: Can repeated W/E contact and passive magic vulnerability justify AP/burn purchases after a reliable Q/R engage? Include allied magic damage and time spent near enemies.

Start with the early core (Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.
Full cost 15,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.
